technical.zh-CN: ATOM 与 ATOM-W 分别为双足和轮式形态；X-Trainer 采用遥操作数据与模仿学习，展示线束端子插拔等任务；Rover X1 使用轮腿切换和双视觉/UWB 感知。
technical.en: ATOM and ATOM-W are bipedal and wheeled respectively. X-Trainer uses teleoperation data and imitation learning for tasks such as cable-terminal insertion. Rover X1 combines wheel-leg switching with dual-vision/UWB sensing.
